run_train_prior: run the Kandinsky 2.2 prior finetuning script with a dataset and validation prompts
build_finetuned_prior: build a finetuned Kandinsky 2.2 prior model on a custom image-caption dataset
test_validation_images: test the finetuned prior by generating validation images from text prompts
save_model_card: save a model card README with training metadata and generated validation images
push_to_hub: push the finetuned prior model and model card to the Hugging Face Hub
